2609.28231.title: Do Center Biases Propagate? Robustness of Pathology Foundation Models in Whole-Slide Image Classification
2609.28231.paper_summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have transformed computational pathology through powerful representation learning from histopathological images. PFMs provide rich, discriminative representations for whole slide image (WSI) analysis, enabling tasks such as slide-level classification under multiple instance learning (MIL). However, these representations may also encode non-biological signals associated with acquisition centers, potentially introducing spurious shortcuts into downstream predictions. In this work, we evaluate center-associated robustness in WSI classification using a controlled training setting with increasing class-center correlations quantified by Cramér's V. We benchmark six PFMs across four datasets and two MIL aggregators, while evaluating ComBat as a robustification strategy. We further introduce the Area Under the Cramér's V Curve (AUCC) to jointly capture absolute classification performance and its degradation as spurious correlation increases. Results show that center-related information encoded by PFMs propagates to WSI-level predictions, with robustness depending on both the PFM representation and MIL aggregation strategy. Additionally, ComBat harmonization does not provide consistent robustness gains across datasets.
2609.28231.paper_summary_zh: 病理基礎模型（PFMs）透過從組織病理學影像中強大的表徵學習，改變了計算病理學。PFMs 為整張幻燈片影像（WSI）分析提供了豐富的、具區別性的表徵，使得在多實例學習（MIL）下進行幻燈片級別分類等任務成為可能。然而，這些表徵也可能編碼與獲取中心相關的非生物信號，潛在地將虛假的捷徑引入下游預測。在本研究中，我們使用控制訓練環境評估 WSI 分類中的中心相關穩健性，並通過 Cramér's V 量化逐漸增加的類別中心相關性。我們在四個數據集和兩個 MIL 聚合器上基準測試六個 PFMs，同時評估 ComBat 作為一種穩健化策略。我們進一步引入 Cramér's V 曲線下的面積（AUCC），以共同捕捉絕對分類性能及其隨虛假相關性增加而下降的情況。結果顯示，PFMs 編碼的與中心相關的信息會傳遞到 WSI 級別的預測中，穩健性取決於 PFM 表徵和 MIL 聚合策略。此外，ComBat 和諧化在不同數據集上並未提供一致的穩健性增益。
